checkpoint: March 11, 2014, 4 p.m. ET (the 2014 league year opens)
authority: Stone's February 2 memo sections 2, 3 and 5 with its dated amendments (stone_to_caldwell_2014_offseason_decisions.md), and the user's instructions of September 29, 2026 recorded there as the amendment 'league-year draws and package I revised'. Caldwell makes every offer on the memo's terms; walk-away figures are ceilings and are not offered.
fa_curve: League rails method section 4: m = 0.5 x (Jacksonville APY / real APY) + 0.5 x (Jacksonville guarantee / real guarantee); APY alone when the real guarantee is zero or not established. Chance 0 below m 0.80; linear 0 to 0.50 from 0.80 to 1.00; linear 0.50 to 0.90 from 1.00 to 1.25; 0.90 above 1.25. Jacksonville wins when the draw is below the chance.
rule_own_real_jaguars: User decision, September 29, 2026: an own pending free agent whose real 2014 move was a re-signing with the real Jaguars is drawn against that real Jaguars contract at its real date, or at 4 p.m. March 11 when that date predates the rails (Marks, December 27, 2013). If Jacksonville loses, he becomes an unplaced unrestricted free agent at 4 p.m. March 11.
rule_uncontested: User decision, September 29, 2026: a target with no rival real contract by the moment Jacksonville's offer can first be signed decides at 4 p.m. March 11 at the 0.90 ceiling (m counts as above 1.25). Applies to Te'o-Nesheim (no 2014 contract found) and Cain (unsigned until Chicago, September 1, 2014).
rule_later_draws: User decision, September 29, 2026: Tate (March 12), Hawkins (Cleveland offer sheet March 12; Cincinnati declined to match March 18), Edelman (agreed March 15) and Jared Allen (March 26) are held to their real dates. Offers are placed, no draw is made and no real term is applied at this checkpoint.
rule_trade_response: User decision, September 29, 2026 (option 1): a club's answer to a Jacksonville pick offer is one private draw on the same curve, with m = chart value sent / chart value asked on the Jimmy Johnson chart. A future pick counts as the middle pick of the round one later per year out (32-team rounds, no compensatory picks); a veteran player counts zero points. Chart source: nflverse nfldata data/draft_values.csv, johnson column (identical values in the leesharpe/nfldata copy): No. 38 = 520, No. 48 = 420, Nos. 144-145 = 34, Nos. 208-209 = 8.

contracts_if_won.shape: Memo section 2 'Roseman shape': a signing bonus prorated over the term, guaranteed 2014 and 2015 base salary, later years non-guaranteed with an early-league-year roster bonus and per-game active bonuses. Signing bonus plus the two guaranteed salaries equal the offered guarantee; the 2014 cap charge equals the memo's 2014 figure. Simulation reconstruction fixed before the draw.

cain.note: One year, $855,000 base (the 2014 minimum for seven to nine credited seasons; his credited seasons are inferred from Chicago's September 2014 minimum figure, single source), no bonus or guarantee; counts $570,000 under the Article 26 minimum-salary benefit (the two-credited-season minimum).

tenders: Due by 4 p.m. March 11: Cameron Bradfield, lowest (right of first refusal) RFA tender, $1,431,000 (2014 amounts Confirmed; publication by March 6). Exclusive-rights tenders at the 2014 minimum for credited seasons: Toney Clemons and Austin Pasztor, two credited seasons (2012 service of at least three games on full-pay status, plus 2013), $570,000; Mike Brown, one credited season (two 2012 weeks on the 53, plus 2013), $495,000. Credited seasons are branch inferences from the contract register. Reisner and Rutland are not tendered.
trade_offers: At 4 p.m.: package I to Arizona (drawn). F1: Nwaneri to San Francisco, first in the memo's call order, for a 2015 sixth; answer open until before March 25. G: shopping opens; no buyer with a documented need is named, so no offer is placed. D: offered to Miami for a 2015 fifth only if Te'o-Nesheim signs. E: only if Arizona declines and Marks is re-signed, Alualu to Miami for a 2015 sixth. A waits on Tate (March 12 draw); H waits on A; F2 waits on the draft.
draw_mechanics: One private packet (method, script and snapshot digests); the service's opaque reference seeds one generator per draw key (SHA-256 of the entropy, packet and key). One draw each, recorded in league_year_results.json. No reroll.
label_swap: Only the offered and real contracts, chart values and dates are inputs.
